contract: Stage two extends the approved graphite/mint workspace into independent agent panels. Primary job: direct and observe concurrent Claude/OpenAI conversations. Primary actions: create an agent, send to each provider, change layout, drag/resize, pin/collapse, and reuse role templates. Keep the existing sidebar and provider-key boundary. Fit default four-up panels to desktop space, retain composers, stack grids on narrow screens and provide keyboard equivalents for layout controls. Local reference: approved stage-one interface and user request to implement stage two.

accessibility.evidence: Axe A/AA checks passed on provider onboarding, empty chat and two active panels. Keyboard focus, Escape, arrow-key resize, labelled per-agent controls and reduced-motion support checked. Not a complete assistive-technology certification.

responsive.evidence: Inspected desktop concurrent/four-agent screenshots and mobile tab/grid screenshots. The default desktop grid fits its composers, narrow grids stack, and browser checks confirm document width never exceeds the viewport.

loading.evidence: Provider tests show Testing connection, streams show Thinking/Stop, and layout changes show Saving until the server acknowledges them.

empty.evidence: Disconnected providers offer setup; empty agents offer a composer; empty templates and archive explain their next action.

error.evidence: Invalid keys preserve existing credentials, provider errors appear inside the affected panel, and labelled model fallbacks remain usable.

partial.evidence: Stopped streams retain partial responses; another provider continues independently. Missing usage/costs stay labelled unavailable or partial.

success.evidence: Connected cards show only last four key characters; created/saved/archived/restored agent actions and completed layout saves provide feedback.

permission.evidence: Account login/logout is covered in the browser. Backend tests deny foreign layouts, agents, templates and runs, and stop a revoked event subscription before publishing further user data.

renderedEvidence.observation: Four independent panels retain readable headers and composers, with per-agent icons and live usage/status, and the existing navigation.
Horizontal tabs select one conversation, the mobile navigation collapses, text wraps and the composer stays inside the viewport.
